title: Audit a light-bending argument
promptMarkdown: A student says: “A horizontal light beam falls by $gL^2/(2c^2)$ across a lift accelerating upward at g. Therefore spacetime inside the lift is curved, and this predicts the full bending of starlight by a star.” Derive the local displacement with its approximations. Identify the two unjustified conclusions separately. Give a precise replacement statement connecting the equivalence principle to the result.
hintLadder: Write both trajectories in the same initial inertial frame.
Ask whether a curved metric was used anywhere.
Identify what is missing when a small lift is replaced by an entire stellar trajectory.
